students.readOnlyDescription: You do not have permission to import students.

scores.title: Import scores
scores.readOnlyDescription: You do not have permission to import scores.
scores.hint: Choose the assignment and the session, then a CSV file with one row per student. Each student is found by their code, and each score column by its parameter name — a parameter can span two columns, "Name (quality)" and "Name (quantity)"; a bare "Name" counts as quality. Empty cells are ignored (they never clear an existing value).
